events.label: Outburst flood (GLOF)
events.detail: Moraine-dammed lake breached on the night of 3-4 Oct 2023; the flood travelled down the Teesta valley and destroyed the Chungthang dam.

source: Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA Copernicus) via AWS Earth Search STAC, COGs on AWS Open Data

method.water: NDWI > 0.1 and NIR <= 0.2, SCL cloud mask
method.ice: NDSI > 0.4 and NIR >= 0.11 (snow and clean ice; debris-covered ice not detected)

method.rule: pixel is perennial ice if NDSI > 0.4 and NIR >= 0.11 (not water) in >= persistence of the late-season scenes in which it was observed; cloud, shadow and cirrus give no vote
method.comparison: every year vs the fixed 2018 baseline, on the pixel grid, only where both years were observed
method.source: Sentinel-2 L2A via AWS Earth Search (satellite-derived)

parent_glacier.note: Diagnostic only. RGI includes debris-covered ice and dates from its source image; differences are partly method, not melt.

neighbour_glacier.note: Diagnostic only. RGI includes debris-covered ice and dates from its source image; differences are partly method, not melt.

metadata.dataset: Randolph Glacier Inventory 7.0 (RGI2000-v7.0-G), region 15 South Asia East
metadata.citation: RGI 7.0 Consortium, 2023. Randolph Glacier Inventory - A Dataset of Global Glacier Outlines, Version 7.0. Boulder, Colorado USA. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. doi:10.5067/f6jmovy5navz
metadata.note: Each outline's source image date is in properties.src_date; RGI targets the year 2000 but individual outlines come from different years. RGI includes debris-covered ice; the Sentinel-2 NDSI composites in this project do not, so the two are not directly subtractable.
